items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: That's Harry Tosen playing clarinet. That's Avery La Pazza playing piano. Myself playing trombone

ctx.x: I wonder what year that was about, do you remember?

No, I don't have any idea what year this was in. That must be over 25 years ago. Oh yeah, that's over 25 years ago. Now those were taken in Biloxi in the Elks Club in Biloxi. You see this is the, this here blacked out part is the death, death of the different Elks that died in the head. Oh yeah. Blacking it out. But you see that's Johnny Bertucci playing trumpet there. That's Harry Tosen playing clarinet. That's Avery La Pazza playing piano. Myself playing trombone and Ellis Stratikas playing drums.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: Well did you tell them when you learned how to play really? When you learned how to play the trombone by notes? When you went to Club Forest?
